purpose: Structural binding choices for the Orkaid CII serializer, fixed before implementation. The projection compares semantic values; these checks are separate and must also pass.

choices.onViolation: SER (PROTOCOL.md section 9, step 2). New evidence that this choice was itself ambiguous or unsupported is recorded separately as a preregistration deviation with a BIND or SRC finding; the mismatch is not reclassified
